title: Flat reduced model with geometrically reduced generic fibre
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a finite type morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] with $S$ irreducible [def-weil-irreducible-components]. There exist a nonempty open $U\subseteq S$, an integral affine scheme $S\prime$ [def-pc-integral-scheme], and a finite universal homeomorphism $q:S\prime\to U$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-universal-homeomorphism] such that $Y=(X\times_S S\prime)_{\mathrm{red}}$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction] is flat and of finite presentation over $S\prime$ [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. If $\eta\prime$ is the generic point of $S\prime$, the fibre $Y_{\eta\prime}$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is geometrically reduced: its base change to every field extension of $\kappa(\eta\prime)$ is reduced [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible].
